title: Ibrance: from cell cycle to clinical practice

scenes.title: The clinical setting
scenes.narration: Begin with an adult patient with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer and frame the labeled treatment setting.
scenes.visual: Clean patient-pathway illustration with receptor status highlighted; no identifiable patient.
scenes.on_screen_text: Start with biology and treatment setting

scenes.title: CDK4/6 and the cell-cycle checkpoint
scenes.narration: Show how palbociclib inhibits CDK4 and CDK6 and blocks progression from G1 into S phase in ER-positive breast cancer cell lines.
scenes.visual: Simple G1-to-S cell-cycle animation with the checkpoint paused.

scenes.title: What PALOMA-2 measured
scenes.narration: Explain the randomized comparison and report median PFS of 24.8 versus 14.5 months, while noting that final overall survival was not statistically significant.
scenes.visual: Two-arm trial layout followed by a restrained PFS comparison.

scenes.title: The 28-day rhythm
scenes.narration: Walk through 21 treatment days followed by 7 days off and connect the schedule to cycle-based monitoring.
scenes.visual: Twenty-eight-day calendar with treatment and rest days clearly separated.

scenes.title: Monitor and respond
scenes.narration: Reinforce CBC monitoring, neutropenia awareness, and immediate interruption and evaluation when ILD or pneumonitis is suspected.
scenes.visual: Monitoring checklist and pulmonary-symptom escalation pathway.
scenes.on_screen_text: Monitor counts. Act on pulmonary symptoms.
